failureNotes.classification: Pre-existing Windows-specific fixture expectation on a case-sensitive Linux filesystem
failureNotes.detail: checkSource checks statSync before exactCase. The deliberately wrong ../Core/config.js path does not exist on Linux, so it reports does not exist; the fixture insists on another letter case. The five other checks, including all real JavaScript and manifest asset references, passed.

failureNotes.classification: Unchanged quiet-wrapper tests: five nested-process output failures and one POSIX missing-command exit-code mismatch
failureNotes.detail: Five assertions receive empty captured output from nested Node processes here; an isolated spawnSync console.log probe returned EPERM with empty stdout/stderr. Separately, tools/nice.mjs returns the bare command on POSIX and maps its spawn error to126, while the existing missing-command fixture expects127. All six failures reproduce from untouched baseline files. The Windows .cmd-only case is skipped.
